name: EatPal - Kids Meal Planning for Picky Eaters
description: The ultimate meal planning app for picky eaters. Create personalized weekly kids meal plans, track safe foods, introduce new foods with daily try bites, and auto-generate grocery lists. Perfect for parents managing selective eating, toddler picky eating, and ARFID.

shortcuts.name: Meal Planner
shortcuts.description: Create weekly meal plans for picky eaters

shortcuts.name: Build a Meal Plan
shortcuts.description: Generate a 5-day plan from your child's safe foods

_protocol_handlers_note: US-850: a web+eatpal handler pointing at /import?url=%s was declared here and removed. There is no /import route in src/App.tsx and nothing in the repo emits a web+eatpal: link, so an installed PWA registered a handler with the OS that could only land on the 404 page. Re-add it in the same change that adds the route, not before -- src/lib/manifestRoutes.test.ts checks every URL this file points at against the router.
